message.content:
Women's cotton woven jacket, unlined, with a collar and button front. It is likely a shirt-jacket or "shacket", which would be classified under 6204.32 (women's suit-type jackets and blazers of cotton) or 6202.92 (women's anoraks, windbreakers and similar articles of cotton).

CBP rulings on similar items usually place a woven cotton jacket with a collar, button front and pockets under 6204.32.4040 (women's other jackets of cotton). Heading 6204 covers suit-type jackets and blazers, while a casual jacket like this one more often goes to 6202.92 only if it is an anorak-type garment. A jacket with a pointed collar, button closure and chest and waist pockets, made of denim or twill, is generally treated as a jacket under 6204.32.

The statistical suffix 6204.32.4040 is for women's cotton jackets, not suit-type, other. The 6204.32.30 line covers "Other: Not ornamented" (6204.32.3000 is a 2012-era line, now 6204.32.3000 for "Other"). The current structure is 6204.32.10 (tailored jackets/blazers, 6204.32.1000), 6204.32.20 (Other, containing 6204.32.2000), 6204.32.30 (6204.32.3000, Other, "Other"), and 6204.32.40 (6204.32.4010 and 6204.32.4020 for knit and woven respectively). I am not fully certain of this breakdown, so I am choosing the general cotton jacket line, 6204.32.4040, as the best fit.
